LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingEnabled: Doctors queue operations on their own
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingEnabledDesc: Off, the doctors queue nothing and only the triage tags and the order of work remain.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingDefaults: How far the doctors may go without orders, by default
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingDefaultsDesc: Each person can be set on their own with the button on them; these are the defaults for anyone you have not set. Guests are people of other factions staying with you.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingMaxDeath: Highest chance of death on the table the doctors may accept alone: {PERCENT}%
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingMaxDeathDesc: The chance the patient dies if the operation fails, times the chance it fails with your best doctor. Riskier operations wait for your own order.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingRareToolsDesc: Some operations consume or risk a costly instrument. Off, those wait for your own order.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingViolations: May operate where it would wrong another faction
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingViolationsDesc: Off, an operation that counts as a violation on a guest or prisoner of another faction waits for your own order.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingMessages: Tell me when an operation is queued, or when no one can do one
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingMessagesDesc: A message when the doctors queue an operation, and one when a condition needs an operation nobody here can do, saying what is missing.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingOrdering: Doctors take the worst case first
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_SettingOrderingDesc: With several patients waiting for operations, a doctor goes to the one in the gravest danger rather than the nearest. Off, the game's own order: the nearest.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_AuthorityDesc: How far the doctors may go for this person without your orders. Bills they queue appear in the operations list like any other and are withdrawn once the condition is gone; bills you add are never touched.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_AuthorityLifeSavingAndCripp: to save life or a limb
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_DetailDyingClock: {CONDITION} will kill them in about {HOURS} hours.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_MessageHeld: {PATIENT}: {CONDITION} needs an operation, and it must wait. {WHY}
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_MessageNoOne: {PATIENT}: {CONDITION} needs an operation and no one here can do it: {WHY}.
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_RefusalItem: an ingredient or tool is missing
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_RefusalTooRisky: it is riskier than you allow
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_RefusalCareLevel: their care level forbids the medicine it needs
LanguageData.PhobosTriage_RefusalRareTool: it needs a rare tool kept for your own orders
